name: Anime Town Huntsville
blurb: A stop of the Anime Town multi-city tour at Huntsville, Alabama's Von Braun Center, with anime voice actors, cosplay and gaming.
notes: Anime Town Huntsville's own page ('Anime Town Huntsville takes place October 2-4, 2026 at the Von Braun Center in Huntsville, Alabama') only shows an edition that had already concluded one day before this check (2026-10-05); no 2027 date is announced yet, so it is recorded as the last edition rather than upcoming. Part of the multi-city Anime Town tour — see the Greenville, Biloxi, Louisiana/Bossier City and Pensacola files for the other stops.
